title: Clarify CommandCenterUI message intent choices
description: Replace protocol-jargon-only Send as choices with plain-language labels and concise contextual help in both the deployed CommandCenterUI and installer template. Preserve the existing inform/request/ack values and send validation behavior. Superseded by TASK-254, which owns independent review and release of the combined final UI state because later serial edits overwrote the earlier worktree snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: The Send as control presents understandable plain-language choices for update, reply-needed request, and acknowledgment while retaining the existing protocol values.
The selected choice has concise explanatory help, including when a reply is expected.
Live and installer composer code remains equivalent and focused checks pass.
